integrity: A complete analytic proof and a standalone finite numerical and language diagnostic accompany the finding. Finite tests cannot prove the infinite theorem; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic response is pointwise in fixed real field t and irrational Sturmian slope; the construction allows every factor length including zero. No uniform quantitative error for arbitrary irrational rotations is asserted. Broader multivariate renewal-thermodynamic priority remains possible.
title: A universal square-root pressure fingerprint for Sturmian-decorated renewal shifts
